race.comment: LADHAR (9) resumes having gone to the paddock a maiden winner at Pakenham, beating a handy field. Prior to that this well-bred filly (out of G1 Blue Diamond winner Lyre) had contested a pair of stakes races. With natural improvement into her 3yo season she can kick off with a win. LA ZOOM (6) was a tough winner on debut at Sale, coming from off pace to score by a neck. Better for that and can remain unbeaten. KOKO (8) broke through for a deserved maiden win here last time out and did it in fine style. Tough draw but can go on with it. HELLUVA BARTY (1) comes back in grade and will be running on. HEIDI DANCER (7) resumes with minor claims.
